title: Restart the OptiSweep Windows Service in Windows Services
summary: Use the Windows Event Viewer / services surface, specifically Windows Services MMC, to locate the OptiSweep service, restart it, and verify that its Status is Running and Startup Type remains Automatic.
when_to_use: Use Windows Services when a tipper heartbeat is flatlined and the source-associated condition is delayed OptiSweep startup relative to Ignition and WCS.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a substitute for a detailed Ignition health check; the supplied source does not provide that check.
Do not use this procedure to diagnose or repair a physical tipper, AGV, or OPC connection fault beyond restarting the OptiSweep Windows service.

roles_and_responsibilities.responsibility: Access Windows Services MMC, inspect the OptiSweep service, restart it, and verify the resulting service state.

safety_notes: Confirm the OptiSweep service state after the restart before treating the recovery as successful.
Escalate rather than repeatedly restarting if the service does not return to Running or the heartbeat remains flatlined.

access_required: L1_support access to the Windows Services MMC on the applicable OptiSweep host
system_preconditions: A tipper heartbeat is flatlined or OptiSweep startup is delayed relative to Ignition and WCS.

visual_references.description: Windows Services MMC showing the OptiSweep service, the Status and Startup Type fields, and the Restart the service control.

steps.title: Open Windows Services and locate OptiSweep
steps.purpose: Access the live Windows service entry associated with the delayed OptiSweep startup.
steps.instruction: In the Windows Event Viewer / services surface, open Windows Services MMC and locate the service named OptiSweep.
steps.expected_result: The OptiSweep service entry is visible with its service controls and Status and Startup Type fields.
steps.healthy_condition: The OptiSweep row is identifiable and its Status and Startup Type values are available for inspection.
steps.failure_condition: The OptiSweep service entry cannot be located in Windows Services.

actions.label: Locate OptiSweep
actions.exact_action: Open Windows Services through the Windows Services MMC and locate the service named OptiSweep.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if the OptiSweep service entry cannot be located.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The Windows Services console shows the OptiSweep service and service controls.

steps.title: Inspect the OptiSweep service state
steps.purpose: Determine whether the displayed service state and startup configuration match the expected live values.
steps.instruction: In Windows Services MMC, select the OptiSweep entry and inspect the displayed Status and Startup Type values.
steps.expected_result: The OptiSweep entry displays Status as Running and Startup Type as Automatic when the service is in the expected state.
steps.healthy_condition: Status is Running and Startup Type is Automatic.
steps.failure_condition: Status is not Running, or Startup Type is not Automatic.

actions.label: Check service fields
actions.exact_action: Check the OptiSweep service entry and note the displayed Status and Startup Type values.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if the OptiSweep entry is not present or its displayed fields cannot be inspected.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The visible OptiSweep service state is Running with Automatic startup.
A flatlined heartbeat is associated with attention to the OptiSweep service.

steps.title: Restart the OptiSweep service
steps.purpose: Recover OptiSweep when its startup is delayed relative to Ignition and WCS.
steps.instruction: In Windows Services MMC, use the service control labeled Restart the service for the OptiSweep entry.
steps.expected_result: The Windows Services console initiates the restart of the OptiSweep service.
steps.healthy_condition: The restart control is available for the OptiSweep entry and the service proceeds to a post-restart state that can be rechecked.
steps.failure_condition: The restart cannot be initiated or the service does not transition back to a Running state.

actions.label: Restart OptiSweep
actions.exact_action: Use the Services console control labeled Restart the service.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the OptiSweep service does not return to Running after the restart.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The Services console includes the Restart the service control for OptiSweep.

steps.title: Verify the post-restart service state
steps.purpose: Confirm that the OptiSweep service recovered with the expected startup configuration.
steps.instruction: Refresh or recheck the OptiSweep entry in Windows Services MMC after the restart and inspect its Status and Startup Type.
steps.expected_result: The refreshed OptiSweep entry displays Status as Running and Startup Type as Automatic.
steps.healthy_condition: Status is Running and Startup Type remains Automatic.
steps.failure_condition: Status remains stopped or otherwise not Running, Startup Type is not Automatic, or the associated heartbeat remains flatlined.

actions.label: Verify post-restart state
actions.exact_action: Recheck the OptiSweep entry after the restart and verify that its Status is Running and its Startup Type remains Automatic.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the OptiSweep service does not return to Running.
Escalate if the heartbeat remains flatlined after the OptiSweep service restart.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The visible OptiSweep service state is Running with Automatic startup, and the segment describes restarting the service when startup is delayed.

success_criteria: The OptiSweep service is visible in Windows Services MMC after the restart.
The OptiSweep Startup Type remains Automatic.
The associated heartbeat is no longer flatlined, when that heartbeat symptom was the trigger.
healthy_conditions: Windows Services MMC shows OptiSweep with Status Running.
Windows Services MMC shows OptiSweep with Startup Type Automatic.
failure_conditions: OptiSweep does not return to Running after the restart.
OptiSweep Startup Type is not Automatic after the restart.
The associated heartbeat remains flatlined after the service restart.
escalation_guidance: Stop and escalate if the OptiSweep service does not return to Running after the restart.
Escalate if the heartbeat remains flatlined after the OptiSweep service restart.
